tagline: A global leader in the development and commercialization of technologies and products for wireless, wired and power markets
hero_kpi_rationale: The HPA segment, growing strongly driven by defense and satellite communications (LEO SATCOM), is the primary engine of Qorvo's structural growth, capturing strategic trends such as the rise of advanced radars and low-earth-orbit satellite networks.

kpis.name: HPA segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue of the High Performance Analog segment that captures advanced technologies such as radars and satellite communications.
kpis.description: The High Performance Analog (HPA) segment saw revenue reach $637.3M in 2025, driven by increased demand in defense, communications and electronic warfare markets.
kpis.signal: HPA growing double digits due to defense and SATCOM demand.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deduction of production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 41.3% in 2025 from 39.5% in 2024, driven by better utilization of production capacity and improved revenue mix.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement from better factory utilization.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 2.6% in 2025, up from 2.4% in 2024, despite significant restructuring and impairment charges.
kpis.signal: Operating margin slightly up despite exceptional charges.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenues invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased to 20.1% of revenue in 2025 from 18.1% in 2024, supported by new technology development and portfolio expansion.
kpis.signal: R&D significantly up, sign of continued innovation.

kpis.name: Capital investments
kpis.explanation: Annual expenditures to maintain or expand production capacity.
kpis.description: Investments reached $137.6M in 2025 versus $127.2M in 2024, reflecting sustained spending despite industrial footprint rationalization.
kpis.signal: Capex modestly up, maintained investments despite rationalization.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Number of employees not mentioned in the documents provided.

kpis.signal: Revenue of $3.679B in latest fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.description: The HPA segment recorded 11.2% growth in 2025, driven by demand for radar products, communications and electronic warfare, as well as the Anokiwave acquisition.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in HPA from defense and SATCOM demand.

risks.title: Dependence on large customers
risks.score_rationale: Risk is at the top of the list and noted as having material effect. Dependence on two customers representing up to 58% of revenue shows critical exposure. Language is repeated and reinforced over multiple years, indicating stable risk profile. High weighting for Competition category.

risks.title: New product design and design wins
risks.score_rationale: This risk is central to operating results analysis. Text emphasizes technical difficulty, long lead times (6-9 months before revenue) and intense competition. Strong language: 'success depends', 'adverse effect'. Technology category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Supply chain disruption
risks.score_rationale: Risk is repeated in multiple places (suppliers, assemblers, Luxshare contracts). Mention of material disruptions, loss of control and third-party dependence. Increased language on capacity and quality constraints. Industrial category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Reduction in U.S. defense spending
risks.score_rationale: Risk is specific and recurring. Explicit mention of past impact ('adversely affected') and sensitivity to political decisions (sequestration, budget pressure). Geopolitical category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Information systems security
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of security breach risks, critical operations disruption and reputational harm. Strong language: 'expose us to liability', 'disrupt', 'suffer'. Cybersecurity category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Fluctuations in operating results
risks.score_rationale: Risk introduced as fundamental, tied to economic cycles, customer demand and macro conditions. Mention of recession, inflation, interest rates. High position in document and repeated language. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Distributor-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Text mentions credit risks, performance risks, difficult replacement and competition through same channels. Less central than others, but still significant. Moderate language. Industrial category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Manufacturing yield issues
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of yield risks, factory qualification, high fixed costs and underutilization. Direct impact on profitability. Precise and concerned technical language. Industrial category moderately weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: QRVO does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments and cost reduction initiatives, with no reference to AI or related technology.
